# “OpenTTD journey”

LuanTTD's main-menu music is “OpenTTD journey” by **-lucas-**, from
[OpenMSX 0.4.2](https://github.com/OpenTTD/OpenMSX/tree/0.4.2). The track and
its stereo Vorbis rendering use the [GNU General Public License version 2](LICENSE.txt).
The [unmodified MIDI](tttheme2.mid) is the preferred source for editing.
The manually rendered recording uses the TimGM6mb SoundFont, copyright Tim
Brechbill and David Bolton; see its [license and exact upstream source](TimGM6mb-debian-copyright.txt).

To reproduce the recording, use FluidSynth with TimGM6mb and make a
32 kHz stereo WAV from the MIDI; convert it with FFmpeg/libvorbis at
quality 0. The original OpenMSX credits and song source are at the link above.
